gloss: somewhat low; on the low side; lowish

definitions.gloss: somewhat low; on the low side; lowish
definitions.explanation: Slightly or relatively low. The suffix め softens the adjective, indicating a tendency or moderate degree rather than an absolute quality.

examples.japanese: {温度|おんど}を{低|ひく}めに{設定|せってい}する。
examples.english: Set the temperature on the low side.

examples.japanese: このシャツは{値段|ねだん}が{低|ひく}めだ。
examples.english: This shirt is priced on the lower side.

examples.japanese: {声|こえ}を{低|ひく}めにして{話|はな}さないと、{周|まわ}りの{人|ひと}に{聞|き}こえてしまう。
examples.english: If you don't keep your voice on the low side, the people around us will hear.

notes:
Formed from {低|ひく}い (low) + the suffix め, which softens adjectives to mean "somewhat" or "on the ... side." This め pattern is extremely productive and commonly used in daily conversation to express preferences or approximate descriptions.

The め suffix attaches to the stem of i-adjectives: {高|たか}め (somewhat high), {大|おお}きめ (somewhat large), {強|つよ}め (somewhat strong), {薄|うす}め (somewhat thin/light).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低|ひく}めに{設定|せってい}する: to set on the low side
- {低|ひく}めの{価格|かかく}: a somewhat low price
- {低|ひく}めの{温度|おんど}: a somewhat low temperature
- {低|ひく}めの{声|こえ}: a lowered voice

OTHER め WORDS:
- {高|たか}め: somewhat high
- {多|おお}め: somewhat more; generous portion
- {少|すく}なめ: somewhat less
- {早|はや}め: somewhat early; on the early side
